free_tier.stated: No numeric quota published, but upload is a *manual web form* reviewed by the CTAN team, with extensive packaging rules (TDS layout, no .git, no editor backups, symlinks preferred over copies). There is no API and no programmatic publish path. A real package (beamer.zip) is 3,298,392 bytes.

retention.stated: per-object-cap: none published; upload is a browser form. retention: indefinite ('CTAN keeps all versions')

egress.terms: Free, heavily mirrored (mirror.ctan.org redirects to a national mirror, e.g. mirrors.ustc.edu.cn). No metering.

tooling: Manual upload form + email-based review. `tlmgr` for consumption. No upload API, no rclone.
chaining: unlimited packages x unlimited versions, but every one is human-reviewed and must be TeX-archive-shaped. Not multiplicable in any meaningful automated way.
